_about: Single routing truth (2026-10-29, plan tiers around Haiku 5.5). state/plan-tier.json picks a column of `tiers`, the agent's role the row; escalation, usage guard and ceiling adjust it; the user's /model and per-turn phrases win. Haiku is the default worker; above 100K prompt tokens it costs 5x, so Haiku roles keep autoCompactWindow at 120000. Merged from ECC the-longform-guide.md#model-routing-table, commands/model-route.md, rules/common/performance.md (the hooks enforce it). model_ids are Agent-tool aliases. Doc: docs/MODEL-ROUTING.md.

roles._comment: subagent_type (lowercased) -> role; unknown -> `default`. `labels`: Workflow opts.label substring -> role when agentType is absent. `guarded`: an explicit model moves these only with the user's phrase (E-04).

tiers_comment: Kept outside `tiers`. ceiling = hardest model any path yields; main = settings `model`; subagent_env = CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL; fallback = fallbackModel; escalate = role's model on escalation; usage_guard = executor ceiling after one step down + fixed judge model while >= 80 %; judge_phrase_lift = judge model when the user's turn says that model's phrase; impl_planned_small = impl model with a plan marker and size <= M; size_bumps = role -> {size: model}; ask_only = models above the tier's routed set that need the user's own phrase this turn for ANY role (an explicit param or label alone is not the user's words). `api` copies `max5`.

agent_pins._comment: Legacy view of tiers.max20 (doctor_checks, docs). The guards read roles+tiers; the consistency test pins this to max20.

task_matrix._comment: TaskProfile intent -> model named by the main-session advice, per tier (api uses max5). Read by model_advice.py only.

heavy_qualifiers._comment: HEAVY_ARCHITECTURE / DEEP_DEBUG main-session advice and the escalation size rule fire only when size:L AND risk>=2 in the TaskProfile — a keyword alone never promotes.

invoke_categories._comment: max20 wording in the generated /invoke skills; the guards' tier routing still applies at dispatch.

escalation._comment: Triggers: a retry_marker, or no plan_marker AND classify size>=min_size AND risk>=min_risk. Target per tier: tiers.<tier>.escalate.<role>. `to`/`agents` = max20 legacy view (doctor_checks). Case-insensitive; any error -> no escalation.

usage_guard._comment: 5-hour window from the statusline bridge (state/session-bridge/*.json, newest, < max_age_s). Active when pct >= on_pct; clears when pct < off_pct or now >= resets_at. Per-tier step-down models: tiers.<tier>.usage_guard.

effort_defaults._comment: Documentation only: agent `effort:` frontmatter is the one lever (Claude Code reads no subagent-effort env var). `max` is banned.
effort_defaults.closers: medium (deadcode-reaper, docs-sync-agent, qa-verifier); santa-reviewer xhigh and security-sentinel high

turn_caps._comment: Agent frontmatter `maxTurns` (the ONLY cap a Workflow agent runs under: agent() has no maxTurns opt). `agents` is the table the frontmatter must equal; `schema_floor` is the minimum per role for every agentType a saved workflow template calls (judges/verifiers/security write a report AND spend one turn on StructuredOutput); `report_reserve` = turns kept for the artifact + StructuredOutput: subagent-context.py tells each agent `deliver by turn max(cap - reserve, cap // 2)`. Sized 2026-10-30 from wf_47c4310f: 8/9 santa-reviewer runs died at exactly 40 turns; the one that returned used 35.

override_phrases._comment: User phrases (last real prompt, lib/model_mode.user_phrase) that let an explicit model move a guarded agent, select fable, or (max5) lift a judge. model_advice stays silent on them.

session_flags._comment: ~/.claude/<dir>/<flag> forces that model on every subagent, capped to the tier ceiling. Cheapest flag wins.

main_session_advice._comment: Heavy-task line for the main model: a task_matrix row of the tier's column + heavy_qualifiers -> dispatch the judge agent in `agents` (pro sonnet; max5 sonnet, 'use opus' lifts; max20 Opus). Else silent. Read by model_advice.py.
